subject: Acme Fasteners LLC has requested a change to how they get paid
text:
Hi Larkspur Industries,

Acme Fasteners LLC, one of your suppliers on PayNet Connect, has requested to receive your future payments through PayNet Instant Pay instead of ACH to their bank account on file.

With Instant Pay, funds are deposited to the supplier's PayNet wallet within minutes and can be withdrawn by the supplier at any time.

What you need to do:
Approve this request so that payments to Acme Fasteners LLC are routed through PayNet Instant Pay.

[Approve request]   [Decline]

If you do not recognize this request, contact PayNet Connect support.

PayNet Connect, Inc.
label: change_request
note: Payment-network notification: switch from ACH to a network wallet, which changes where the money lands. No bank numbers.
